notes.title: Official release
notes.notes:
Patrons enjoyed the taverns of Slash Roll for several months, honing the rules of this fancy game, and are now ready to push to the next level of competitivity.

Slash Roll is now officially released and comes with brand new assets to add diversity throughout the runs.

notes.title: The drunkard has arrived
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37120910/d54d3ff564365329fc344104cd756c8a00da4096.png[/img]

It is said some ancient species were able to ascend to a higher plane of existence, and so does the drunkard .. or at least, you are convinced of this.

[h3]Slash Roll 0.4 is now available.[/h3]

The traveller is now faster to unlock (req: Hero lv2) and the new available character, the Drunkard, can be played after having cleared the third inn at least once with another class.
The new mechanics coming with the [i]consume[/i] ability will require you to build innovative strategies.


Note: If you were already on the beta branch, only minor balancing changes took place.

[url=https://discord.gg/aFAeyM9]Join us on Discord[/url]

notes.title: The traveller is here
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37120910/3dcdbaa75ce410c7a9a7851caeebfd3779e80a4b.png[/img]

Mathilda, the quest giver, has just finished sorting adventure opportunities, as Sam, the conscientious overseer, lifts the entrance panel.
[b]A new tavern is open![/b]
In the meantime, the wonders of the world await the traveller, from the tallest monuments to the deepest landscapes .. you might just need someone for directions.

[h3]Slash Roll 0.3.0 is now available.[/h3]
[list][*] 87 dice, including non-dice
[*] 60 opponents with different gameplays, including 9 bosses
[*] 41 modifiers, including game-breaking combos
[*] 27 weird encounters, including a tutorial :-)
[*] 3 taverns, each with a different clientele
[*] 2 playable classes, from level 0 to level 9
[*] 31 achievements .. gotta catch'em all
[/list]

This major update brings a new tavern with 20 new opponents with each a specific modifer.
The traveller, new class available, with their new special ability changes completely the value of the dice already played by the hero. On top of that, 17 new dice, common to be both classes or specific to the traveller can be added to your pouch.
Instead of 0-3 levels, 0-9 levels are now available. The old level 3 is equivalent to the new level 9, in terms of difficulty, giving you more margin in the beginning to learn how to find the best moves.

Note: If you were already on the beta branch, only minor balancing changes took place.

[url=https://discord.gg/aFAeyM9]Join us on Discord[/url]

notes.title: Available now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37120910/52d4eb34d15bd4dd2e8cc0c0b95a4ab834f8fccf.png[/img]

Betty, the waitress, is just done with her last sweep, as Donovan, the barman, opens the door.
[b]The tavern is open![/b]
Who might well be the next customer? A mighty hero taking his well deserved leisure time playing dice games most likely .. or, at least, that's how you advertise it.

[h3]Slash Roll 0.2.0 is now available.[/h3]
[list][*] 70 dice, including non-dice
[*] 40 opponents with different gameplays, including 6 bosses
[*] 35 modifiers, including game-breaking combos
[*] 27 weird encounters, including a tutorial :-)
[*] 2 taverns, each with a different clientele
[*] 1 playable class, the hero, from level 0 to level 3
[*] 31 achievements .. gotta catch'em all
[/list]

A [b]public beta branch[/b] is available in parallel to the default one.
You can opt-in to get the hottest build of the day.

For all issues, ideas, or just a simple hello, feel free to [b]join us on [url=https://discord.gg/aFAeyM9]Discord[/url][/b].
You can also post something in the [b]Steam Community forum[/b].

If you are a [b]creator[/b] or know one who would love to try Slash Roll, drop us a note and share your experience with us. We would love to watch your content.


[url=https://discord.gg/aFAeyM9]Join us on Discord[/url]

notes.title: Early-access is announced
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37120910/0f186e853bd545acde1adf029a30d26977272478.png[/img]

Tables are cleared, new barrels are on the way, everything gets ready for the new wave of heroes to come.
Patrons are honing their skills between themselves and the tavern-keeper is training his throw.

Thanks for waiting, [b]Slash Roll[/b] finally has an [b]early-access[/b] date! [b]April 13th[/b]!

However, this will only be the beginning of a long journey. The inn business is getting popular in the area and nifty entrepreneurs are investing in the construction of [i]new establishments[/i]: they believe [i]tourism[/i] is the future ...
